programmes.d: Phillip Stroh (BILLY BURKE) returns and is demanding a new deal from DDA Rios (NADINE VELAZQUEZ) in exchange for his cooperation regarding "future murders."
Raydor reaches out to a consultant (ANNIE POTTS) to help reverse-engineer a decade of horrible murders as Phillip Stroh (BILLY BURKE) moves closer to achieving his ultimate deal.
In the season premiere, Major Crimes investigates a double homicide in the Hollywood Hills. Meanwhile, Sanchez attempts to reintegrate himself in the division after his suspension.
When a dead body pops out of the trunk after a car chase, Major Crimes must the untangle connections between many different people and professions. PAUL SCHULTZE guest stars.
Major Crimes investigates the murder of a supermodel with close ties to a pompous celebrity photographer (JAMIE BAMBER). Raydor and Rusty are both served subpoenas.
A decomposed body is discovered in a tub of acid at a naval base and Ducky and Abby learn that the victim was a submariner.(TV-PG)

The NCIS team head to Cuba to investigate a Navy translator's connection to smuggling at a detention center after he suddenly dies at the wheel of his car when returning to the U.S. from Guantanamo Bay. (TV-PG)
After a marine widow receives a call from her dead husband, the NCIS team takes on the case and has to exhume the body to deduce whether the call was a prank or not. (TV-PG)
After being buried alive, a woman comes out of the grave with amnesia and the only thing she remembers is that there is a bomb aboard a Navy ship. (TV-PG)

When a Navy commander, who was a technical advisor to a civilian contractor creating a handheld sonar scanner, is found dead on the beach, the NCIS team investigates the murder using satellite technology. (TV-PG)
The NCIS team is called in when a severed leg bearing a marine tattoo is found in a trash bin, leading them to a small town where a murder scheme is afoot. (TV-PG)
The team investigates when a Marine recruitment officer is found shot to death by a sniper with a grudge, who leaves a white feather behind. (TV-PG)

The team investigates a murder with the help from a local sheriff, Charley, when they find out about similar murders of a Navy civilian employee and a pilot who was going through a nasty divorce. (TV-PG)
Gibbs risks his career when his former commanding officer is accused of stealing funds. (TV-PG)
A terrorist holds Ducky, Gerald and Kate hostage while the rest of the NCIS team tries to figure out how the terrorist got inside and how to get their people out safely. (TV-PG)
When the body of a marine is found after a party in an illegal night club, the team investigates a number of possible leads - including blackmail and accidental death. (TV-PG)
The team is looking for an ex-SEAL who escaped from prison in search of revenge. He is determined to find the real murderer of his wife. (TV-PG)
In his first outing as a Reserve Officer, Buzz finds a dead body in a hotel room, threatening, among other things, Flynn and Provenza's plans to take the squad to a baseball game.

As the Major Crimes unit investigates a complicated gangland shooting, Detective Amy Sykes finds she must protect the identity of a witness capable of identifying the killer.
The squad tries to identify a possible murder victim from his skeletal remains, only to find he may have a criminal past of his own. A new friend helps Rusty with the Alice case.
After a shooting leaves two LA police officers dead, Major Crimes must work with Deputy Chief Fritz Howard (JON TENNEY) of the Special Operations Bureau to piece together the case.
New information prompts the re-opening of an old investigation, forcing Captain Raydor and her Major Crimes division into partnership with a potentially corrupt FBI agent.
Major Crimes must decide whether a victim was targeted or a potential suicide. Rusty asks Sharon for help as he finally finds Alice Herrera's brother.
After Major Crimes identifies a murder victim as the son of a judge known for being tough on criminals (PATRICIA WETTIG), the squad hunts through her current case load.
Four wealthy one-percenters are left for dead outside a hospital emergency room in a twisty murder case that leads through an impossible list of suspects.
